p: Being opposite the Metro makes this Admiral an easy stop on Nile Street, right in the middle of North Shields. It's an adult gaming centre, which means 18+ only.

If you've got a bit of time, walk down the bank to the Fish Quay. It's still a working fishing quay, lined with chippies, seafood restaurants and pubs, and the old Low Lights and High Lights stand above it. The Shields Ferry crosses the Tyne from nearby to South Shields, a cheap and cheerful little river trip. Tynemouth is only a stop or two along the Metro, with its priory and castle on the headland, Longsands beach and a weekend market in the Victorian station.
